notes.title: Carve Your Own Path to the Podium in MX vs ATV Legends - Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7564110/d5d2dae199c35b3a9b14f707dd978939fd2c8dad.jpg[/img] 

[b]Carve Your Own Path to the Podium in MX vs ATV Legends - Available Now![/b]
 
Vienna, Austria / Phoenix, Arizona, June 28, 2022 – THQ Nordic and Rainbow Studios today announced the release of MX vs ATV Legends! Now available for PlayStation 4, PlayStation5, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, and PC, Legends takes players from casual, coastal rides on top of their favorite UTV to taking control of the fastest machines on two wheels to compete in relentless series events! MX vs ATV Legends features a deep career mode, all-new, massive open environments as well unprecedented vehicle and gear customization! A Refined physics system and a split-screen, as well as an up-to-16-player online multiplayer PLUS the BIGGEST OEM vehicle DLC in the franchise's history, make "Legends" the most ambitious installment in the whole series. 

Check out the launch trailer here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RHU8amMVr7E

MX vs ATV Legends is available now for PS4™, PS5™, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, as well as PC at an SRP of $ 39.99 / € 39.99, £ 34.99. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205970/MX_vs_ATV_Legends

Also make sure to check out the bundles available!
[b]Leader Pack[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25612/MX_vs_ATV_Legends_Leader_Pack/
[b]Icon Pack[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25613/MX_vs_ATV_Legends_Icon_Pack/
[b]MX vs ATV Collection[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/355/MX_vs_ATV_Collection/

Enjoy & stay tuned!

notes.title: THQ Nordic and Rainbow Studios Announce MX vs ATV All Out!
notes.content:
[b]All Terrain, All Vehicles, All You![/b]

Karlstad, Sweden, Vienna, Austria and Phoenix, AZ – September 14, 2017. – THQ Nordic and Rainbow Studios today announced the complete off-road racing and lifestyle experience, MX vs ATV All Out http://www.mxvsatv.com. Currently in development for PC, PlayStation®4 computer entertainment system and Xbox® One, MX vs ATV All Out is slated for release in early 2018. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/520940/MX_vs_ATV_All_Out/

“All Out is the culmination of Rainbow’s decades-long commitment to creating the most comprehensive and FUN off-road racing games!” said Klemens Kreuzer, Managing Director, THQ Nordic GmbH. “Whether your pulling off stunts on your own private compound, exploring wide-open terrain in a UTV, or racing in 16-player online competitions, All Out invites players of all ages and skill levels to experience the freedom of racing and competing off-road.”

Website: http://www.mxvsatv.com

In MX vs ATV All Out, choose between bikes, ATVs and UTVs, refine your rider style at your private compound, blast across massive open worlds and compete head to head in various game modes! The all new Freestyle mode allows you to win with style and crazy stunts! Or go All Out and show your riding skills in Multiplayer!

Stay tuned
Your THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore Update 1.10
notes.content:
Thanks to all of the feedback and thorough bug reports that we've received from you since the game has launched we are very happy to roll out this update for MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore!

Here's what you can expect and look for once you get this installed and load up your game again:
[list]
[*]Fixed HD rendering not scaling; now properly supports HD and 4K resolutions
[*]Improved overall rendering visuals and performance
[*]Adjusted terrain detail scaling based on resolution and texture setting, improves low-end performance
[*]Fixed "dual terrain" issue
[*]Improved trees' memory usage and corrected rendering on AMD graphics
[*]Improved online connectivity and playlist functionality
[*]Added new Settings options
[*]Linked Turning-Reflex option for keyboard
[*]Graphics Adaptor selection
[*]Fixed issue where Settings were not saving properly
[*]Several other minor bug fixes 
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the improved experience and have more DLC including levels and OEM vehicles on the way shortly!

BRAAAAAAAP!!!!!!!

notes.title: We are out of early access! Huge update released!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that we have rolled out the biggest update yet for MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore! This release adds the Rhythm Racing mode, more Nationals outdoor tracks, Waypoint Races, all new HD rendering, and improved physics handling! Various bugs have also been addressed.

This will be the last content update as we will now focus on optimizing the game for certain hardware and addressing the last remaining bugs. 

Here are more details about the changes and additions for this update:
-	5 Rhythm Racing tracks
-	9 more National outdoor tracks
-	4 Waypoint races
-	All new graphics kits for bikes
-	All new rider gear
-	Upgraded to HD rendering
-	Reworked and fine-tuned driving physics for bikes and ATVs
-	New Main Menu visuals
-	Various bug fixes

[b]PLEASE NOTE:[/b]  With this major update all player data will be reset.

While you download the update, make sure to watch the brand new launch trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fo4KPBHMJPs

Screenshots:
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/08_Nat.jpg[/img]
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/09_RR.jpg[/img]
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/10_SX.jpg[/img]
[img]http://mxvsatv.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/07_WP.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoy and look forward to your feedback! Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Early Access Update #4: Devil’s Playground
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce that we have rolled out another update!  This release addresses various network and crash bugs that should improve your online experience.

The Devil’s Playground Open World environment from MX vs. ATV Alive has also had its first pass done being integrated on to the PC.  You’ll notice that the trees are currently absent however they will be added back in a future update.

Here’s a summary of the bug fixes for this update:
[list]
[*]Alt-tab issues in single and multiplayer
[*]Mic issues in multiplayer
[*]Race position and distance between players in multiplayer not synching up
[*]Incorrect “Join Game” option via Steam friends list has been addressed
[*]Resolved issues that players were having when creating private online matches
[*]Fixed invisible rider/bike
[/list]
Check out the video below to get a preview of the Devil’s Playground Open World (the dunes level) and thank you for your continued support! 
http://youtu.be/n2JCZY84Jk8

notes.title: Supercross Encore Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
We're pleased to announce that the next update of MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore is scheduled for mid-July, and it will mark an important milestone for our game. In the update we will be adding the first open world map from Alive allowing you to Free ride and explore in a bigger environment. The update will also feature several bug fixes such as more online improvements along with some added functional stability. 

Since we've been working hard on many under the hood improvements, this also means that we are unable to release any update before mid-July. This is because we are in the middle of development and releasing unfinished code would just make the game less enjoyable for our dear players and supporters.

The next update is a first, important step for Supercross Encore. Now with most of the heavy lifting done on the under the hood improvements we are working on new content to come in the following months: many more tracks from MX vs. ATV Alive, completely new Rhythm Racing events and Waypoint races, true HD rendering for tracks and bikes plus new gear that is officially licensed by top motocross companies.

As always, thank you for your enthusiasm, dedication and support.

Rainbow Studios

Dear MX vs. ATV fans,

we are glad to announce that the back catalogue jewel MX vs. ATV Unleashed has found its way to Steam finally.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/359220
We hope you enjoy that 2006 release.

Stay tuned!
Your Nordic Games Team

notes.title: MASSIVE Content Update for MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that we have released our first content update to Early Access and it’s a big one! This release includes: 

- 13 additional tracks from the original MX vs. ATV Supercross 
- Career mode to unlock all of these tracks and bikes 
- 450cc Bikes & ATV’s 
- 650cc Bike & ATV 
- 50cc Mini Bike 

Our next update will address some of the bugs that have been found along with online issues.

Rainbow Studios

notes.title: MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore has entered Early Access status!
notes.content:
Dear MX vs. ATV fans,

We are happy to announce that MX vs. ATV Supercross Encore is now available as an Early Access version. 

We kindly ask you to read the following points for more information regarding this Early Access version

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
Early Access is a great and unique way for you to get your hands on an early version of our game and help us make it even better. Be the first to see new content and features during the fine-tuning and tweaking phase of the game. We look forward to your constructive and valuable feedback.

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]
We are targeting the full release in Summer 2015.

[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]
Early Access will have gameplay features and tracks come online as the game is being worked on. We plan to deliver new content updates every month. The full version will contain the career mode where you can unlock additional game modes, vehicles and parts. Furthermore, the full version will include more than 30 tracks, whereas the Early Access version will have less.

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]
The initial Early Access build of the game includes:
- Single and multiplayer mode
- 4 tracks with high-res textures (we plan to add new tracks monthly)
- 6 vehicles (2 x 125cc bikes, 2 x 250cc bikes, 2 x 250cc ATVs) 
- Upgrade parts for all vehicles
- More than 60 official riders

[b]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/b]
We are going to scale the price with the amount of content available. So as more content is added, we will add to the cost incrementally. We hope that players will feel they paid the appropriate price at any given stage of the development.

[b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b]
The Rainbow Studios development team highly values your feedback. We encourage you to post feedback on the Steam forums, where we monitor all of the posts.


Enjoy and we are looking forward to your feedback!
Stay tuned!
Your Nordic Games Team
